title: Proteomics of Homeobox7 Enhanced Salt Tolerance in Mesembryanthemum crystallinum.
authors: Zhang, Xuemei; Tan, Bowen; Zhu, Dan; Dufresne, Daniel; Jiang, Tingbo; Chen, Sixue
one_liner_zh: 该文研究冰叶日中花转录因子McHB7过表达提升耐盐性的蛋白组学，未涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属转录因子功能与耐盐生理研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Mesembryanthemum crystallinum (common ice plant) is a halophyte species that has adapted to extreme conditions. In this study, we cloned a McHB7 transcription factor gene from the ice plant. The expression of McHB7 was significantly induced by 500 mM NaCl and it reached the peak under salt treatment for 7 days. The McHB7 protein was targeted to the nucleus. McHB7-overexpressing in ice plant leaves through Agrobacterium-mediated transformation led to 25 times more McHB7 transcripts than the non-transformed wild type (WT). After 500 mM NaCl treatment for 7 days, the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and peroxidase (POD) and water content of the transgenic plants were higher than the WT, while malondialdehyde (MDA) was decreased in the transgenic plants. A total of 1082 and 1072 proteins were profiled by proteomics under control and salt treatment, respectively, with 22 and 11 proteins uniquely identified under control and salt stress, respectively. Among the 11 proteins, 7 were increased and 4 were decreased after salt treatment. Most of the proteins whose expression increased in the McHB7 overexpression (OE) ice plants under high salinity were involved in transport regulation, catalytic activities, biosynthesis of secondary metabolites, and response to stimulus. The results demonstrate that the McHB7 transcription factor plays a positive role in improving plant salt tolerance.
abstract_zh: 冰叶日中花（Mesembryanthemum crystallinum，常见冰菜）是一种适应极端条件的盐生植物。在本研究中，我们从冰菜中克隆了一个McHB7转录因子基因。McHB7的表达在500 mM NaCl处理下显著诱导，并在盐处理7天时达到峰值。McHB7蛋白定位于细胞核。通过农杆菌介导的转化在冰菜叶片中过表达McHB7，导致McHB7转录本比未转化的野生型（WT）多25倍。在500 mM NaCl处理7天后，转基因植物的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化物酶（POD）活性及水分含量高于野生型，而丙二醛（MDA）在转基因植物中降低。在对照和盐处理条件下，蛋白质组学分别鉴定了1082和1072种蛋白质，其中在对照和盐胁迫下分别有22和11种蛋白质被独特鉴定。在这11种蛋白质中，盐处理后7种增加，4种减少。在高盐条件下，McHB7过表达（OE）冰菜中表达增加的蛋白质大多涉及转运调控、催化活性、次生代谢物生物合成及对刺激的响应。结果表明，McHB7转录因子在提高植物耐盐性中发挥积极作用。
